baseline_scope: Checked-out source comparison, not a claim about every running process.
implemented: Pure explicit-whitelist strategy registry with immutable copied specs and deployment snapshots.
Stable consumer identity matching existing account-plus-producer scope, excluding code version and generation.
Typed immutable TradePlan with explicit direction, account, deployment generation, expiry and exit version/config.
Exact risk-distance and non-power-of-ten quantity-step checks independent of ambient Decimal precision.
Bounded JSON configuration recovery rejecting duplicate keys, credential-named fields and floating-point values.
Purpose-specific legacy S6/S8 protection projection integrated into DirectionalStopRecovery.plan.
Preserved original protection ownership checks and no additional requirement for entry freshness, model availability or research-only fields.

compatibility_boundaries.legacy_software_exit_policy: Current account policy remains current; not retroactively frozen at entry.
compatibility_boundaries.partial_fill_contract: Original requested quantity identifies the admission plan; actual remaining exposure belongs to the ledger and guarded installer.
compatibility_boundaries.partial_entry_tests: Real isolated-PG admission and ledger, explicit fake complete fill evidence; plan reading only, not a real venue stop installation.
compatibility_boundaries.partial_exit_test: Real service, state and ledger chain with fake venue responses; confirms remaining exposure and no duplicate close submission.
compatibility_boundaries.consumer_tests: Identity compatibility only; no new cross-instance opportunity execution fence is claimed.

independent_review_fixes: Reconstruct and copy AccountScope at plan and binding boundaries.
Reconstruct and copy StrategySpec on registration and binding.
Share strategy/handler identifier and exact JSON-safe generation validation between registry and plan.
Reject duplicate configuration keys at all nesting levels.
Bound both incoming UTF-8 bytes and canonical JSON output bytes, including Unicode escape expansion.

qa.network_boundary: tests/v2_core/conftest.py rejects AF_INET/AF_INET6 connect and sendto; PostgreSQL and Redis use dedicated Unix sockets.

initial_regression.failure: Two new partial-entry test fixtures omitted fills_complete evidence when cancelling a submitted order; existing Orders safety check correctly refused cancellation.
initial_regression.resolution: Fixed fixture with explicit complete simulated fill set and asserted state/version transitions; Orders business checks unchanged.

qa.scope: Targeted contract and affected trading-chain regression, not the whole repository or real exchange acceptance.

controller_observation.scope: Read-only service metadata, not a full trading health check.

remaining_before_p1_acceptance: Complete P0 runtime SLO and resource baseline measurement; source baseline alone does not freeze operating performance.
Persist and atomically fence deployment bindings at actual order authorization; handle PREPARED, SUBMITTING and UNKNOWN across switches.
Persist account-wide opportunity ownership across instances and versions, retaining consumption after a position closes.
Read new and old plans through admission, dispatch, software exit, cash verification, lifecycle, settlement and analytics.
Version actual exit handlers for new plans and retain support for active old plans without silently migrating existing positions.
Isolate strategy computation and model waits from protection and exit scheduling, including hard-timeout and resource-pressure tests.
Run complete isolated lifecycle, fault recovery, concurrency and bounded-load acceptance before enabling any new strategy.
profitability_claim: None. No new strategy returns or executable market advantage have been demonstrated by these contract tests.
